qs.q: A patient with osteoporosis and recurrent falls is managed with non-pharmacological interventions. Which multidisciplinary team should be involved to address unsteadiness?
o: Falls prevention team including occupational therapy
qs.e: Patients with recurrent falls or unsteadiness should be referred to a multidisciplinary falls prevention team such as occupational therapy. Other non-pharmacological measures include smoking cessation and adequate dietary calcium.

qs.q: In the management of a patient with a lung abscess or suppuration in the lower lobes, which non-pharmacological intervention is considered of great value?
qs.e: Physiotherapy is of great value, especially when suppuration is present in the lower lobes or when a large abscess cavity has formed. Radiotherapy has no role in the treatment of infectious lung abscesses.

qs.q: Which non-pharmacological intervention is specifically noted to reduce the risk of hip fracture in high-risk patients?
qs.e: Hip protectors can reduce the risk of hip fracture. Braces and sleeves are not indicated for hip protection against falls.
